articles.title: Controversial bishops ordained as Pope warns of 'schism' in Catholic Church
articles.description: Thousands of worshippers attended a ceremony in the Swiss Alps as part of the breakaway Society of Saint Pius X.

articles.title: Afghan Taliban launch strikes on border with Pakistan as tensions escalate
articles.description: Pakistan's military says it shot down four rudimentary drones and will respond to any further provocation.

articles.title: Five people injured after firebomb attacks targeting politicians in Greece
articles.description: Three pre-dawn firebomb attacks apparently targeting the residences of members of Greece's governing conservative New Democracy party have left five people in hospital, with one in a serious condition
